body:
GitHub https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/1487

## Summary
With `additional_repositories` declared in a `corvint-corpus-input/2` manifest, every `corvint-corpus-mcp` tool call recomputes live freshness for all repositories and never reuses it. On a ~100k-record corpus warm calls take ~10 s (freshness ~10 s, query ~70 ms), against ~1.1 s for the same corpus shape anchored in one repository on the previous build. The first call of a session takes ~30 s.

## Environment
- Build: main-ef2a01d (macOS arm64).
- Corpus: adoption-provider shards, 9,068 pinned inputs: primary repository (shards and one case export) plus 4 additional repositories with 7,312 / 1,659 / 84 / 9 pinned inputs. Checkouts are clean, detached at their pinned revisions, 12k / 3k / 0.8k / 0.3k tracked files. ~64k subjects, ~19k claims, ~26k relations, 217 journeys, 4,013 supplied gaps. Artifact 89 MB.

## Reproduction
1. Build the corpus (19.4 s, 1.16 GB RSS).
2. Start `corvint-corpus-mcp --root <primary> --artifact corpus.json --legacy-cases` and send 94 calls across all tools.
3. Read `_meta["corvint/timing"]`.

## Measured
| | value |
|---|---|
| first call | 29.6 s: load 19.2 s + freshness 10.1 s, 36 CPU-s |
| warm calls (86) | `load: reused`, `freshness: computed` on every call; freshness mean 10.0 s (min 8.8 s), verify 0.28 s, query mean 69 ms (max 577 ms); wall mean 9.9 s, p95 13.3 s; 12.9 CPU-s per call |
| peak RSS | 1.39 GB |
| previous build, single repository, same scale | warm mean 1.14 s, freshness ~0.43 s reused |

`internal/doccorpus/query.go` (`liveFreshness`) clears the observation key as soon as an additional repository is checked ("the overlay carries no reusable observation key"), so reuse can never apply.

## Expected
- Freshness reuse works per repository: an observation key per declared checkout (HEAD, status digest), and an unchanged set of keys reuses the previous overlay.
- Warm-call freshness cost does not grow with the number of pinned inputs when no checkout changed.

## Acceptance tests
- Fixture: primary + 2 additional repositories, >= 8,000 pinned inputs. Second and later calls report `freshness: reused` and freshness_ms < 100 ms while no checkout changes.
- Changing one file in one additional repository makes the next call recompute (stale, naming that repository) and later calls reuse again.
- Warm p95 < 1 s for `docs_get`/`docs_search` on that fixture.
